Agios Nikolaos Lefkada – the kite spot"><div data-testid="linkElement" class="apPOZK"><img fetchpriority="high" sizes="980px" WRchTxtk wixui-rich-text" data-testid="richTextElement"><h2 class="font_2 wixui-rich-text__text" style="font-size:40px; line-height:1.4em;"><span style="font-size:40px;" class="wixui-rich-text__text"><span style="font-weight:normal;" class="wixui-rich-text__text"><span style="font-family:signika,sans-serif;" class="wixui-rich-text__text"><span style="letter-spacing:normal;" class="wixui-rich-text__text">Kitesurf in Lefkada&nbsp;<br class="wixui-rich-text__text">
Guide to the Agios Nikolaos<br class="wixui-rich-text__text">
Kite Spot</span></span></span></span></h2></div><div id="WRchTxtl" class="N8MGzv _v6ohL AWXfZq PO9MfV WRchTxtl wixui-rich-text" data-testid="richTextElement"><p class="font_8 wixui-rich-text__text" style="font-size:14px;"><span style="font-size:14px;" class="wixui-rich-text__text">The lagoon of Agios Nikolaos, Lefkada is one of the most popular kitesurfing locations in Greece.</span></p>

<p class="font_8 wixui-rich-text__text" style="font-size:14px;"><span style="font-size:14px;" class="wixui-rich-text__text">Located on the beautiful island of Lefkada, the spot offers shallow flat water and reliable thermal wind during the summer months.</span></p>

<p class="font_8 wixui-rich-text__text" style="font-size:14px;"><span style="font-size:14px;" class="wixui-rich-text__text">These conditions make it perfect for beginners as well as experienced riders.</span></p>

<h3 class="font_3 wixui-rich-text__text" style="font-size:36px;"><span style="font-size:36px;" class="wixui-rich-text__text">Wind conditions</span></h3>

<p class="font_8 wixui-rich-text__text" style="font-size:14px;"><span style="font-size:14px;" class="wixui-rich-text__text">During summer, a thermal wind develops almost every afternoon.</span></p>

<p class="font_8 wixui-rich-text__text" style="font-size:14px;"><span style="font-size:14px;" class="wixui-rich-text__text">Typical conditions:</span></p>

<ul class="font_8 wixui-rich-text__text" style="font-size:14px;">
<li class="wixui-rich-text__text">
<p class="font_8 wixui-rich-text__text" style="font-size:14px;"><span style="font-size:14px;" class="wixui-rich-text__text">Wind: 15&ndash;20 knots</span></p>
</li>
<li class="wixui-rich-text__text">
<p class="font_8 wixui-rich-text__text" style="font-size:14px;"><span style="font-size:14px;" class="wixui-rich-text__text">Direction: side-onshore</span></p>
</li>
<li class="wixui-rich-text__text">
<p class="font_8 wixui-rich-text__text" style="font-size:14px;"><span style="font-size:14px;" class="wixui-rich-text__text">Best months: May to September</span></p>
</li>
</ul>

<p class="font_8 wixui-rich-text__text" style="font-size:14px;"><span style="font-size:14px;" class="wixui-rich-text__text">This makes Lefkada one of the most reliable summer kitesurfing destinations in Greece.</span></p>

<h3 class="font_3 wixui-rich-text__text" style="font-size:36px;"><span style="font-size:36px;" class="wixui-rich-text__text">The lagoon</span></h3>

<p class="font_8 wixui-rich-text__text" style="font-size:14px;"><span style="font-size:14px;" class="wixui-rich-text__text">The lagoon of Agios Nikolaos is known for its flat water and shallow depth.</span></p>

<p class="font_8 wixui-rich-text__text" style="font-size:14px;"><span style="font-size:14px;" class="wixui-rich-text__text">This makes it ideal for:</span></p>

<ul class="font_8 wixui-rich-text__text" style="font-size:14px;">
<li class="wixui-rich-text__text">
<p class="font_8 wixui-rich-text__text" style="font-size:14px;"><span style="font-size:14px;" class="wixui-rich-text__text">beginners learning to kite</span></p>
</li>
<li class="wixui-rich-text__text">
<p class="font_8 wixui-rich-text__text" style="font-size:14px;"><span style="font-size:14px;" class="wixui-rich-text__text">freestyle riders</span></p>
</li>
<li class="wixui-rich-text__text">
<p class="font_8 wixui-rich-text__text" style="font-size:14px;"><span style="font-size:14px;" class="wixui-rich-text__text">people progressing their skills</span></p>
</li>
</ul>

<p class="font_8 wixui-rich-text__text" style="font-size:14px;"><span style="font-size:14px;" class="wixui-rich-text__text">The wide open space also allows many riders to enjoy the spot comfortably.</span></p>

<h3 class="font_3 wixui-rich-text__text" style="font-size:36px;"><span style="font-size:36px;" class="wixui-rich-text__text">Where to stay</span></h3>

<p class="font_8 wixui-rich-text__text" style="font-size:14px;"><span style="font-size:14px;" class="wixui-rich-text__text">If you are looking for accommodation close to the kite spot, Villa Pefkakia is located only a few minutes away.</span></p>

<p class="font_8 wixui-rich-text__text" style="font-size:14px;"><span style="font-size:14px;" class="wixui-rich-text__text">Our small guesthouse overlooks the lagoon and offers a relaxed place to stay after a great day on the water.</span></p>
